instruction: Consume the V1 cognitive stress WITHHOLD as mandatory negative experience. Preserve the three PASS shadow organ genes. Build a generic conflict representation from the number of distinct simultaneously matched native routes, whether the state is known, and organ identity. Use YADO's already-active generic conjunctive learner to learn PASS_THROUGH versus WITHHOLD; do not hand-write the arbitration rule. Validate on a new holdout containing fresh irrelevant perturbations, unknown states, all compatible pair conflicts, and compatible three-route conflicts. Clean single-route states must preserve the original decision; zero-route unknown or multi-route conflict states must fail closed. Require guard fresh >=0.95, material ablation, exact clean/unknown/conflict behavior, each organ stress >=0.95 and composite >=0.95. Keep canonical unchanged.
